description: Delete a category group and every category in it. Destructive and irreversible: the first call only previews, and deleting requires confirm: true plus confirm_name set to the group's exact name. You must specify a category to transfer orphaned categories' transactions to.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete. Without it, the tool only previews.

confirm_name.description: The group's exact name, echoed back as a safeguard.

group.description: Category group name or ID to delete

transfer_to.description: Category name or ID to transfer orphaned transactions to

name: delete_category_group
